insight: Leave lane proactively at key times (6+ min windows) instead of reacting to enemy movements. Proactive rotations control the game and tilt enemy supports. Reactive rotations (TP after enemy act) limit your impact—you're only 70% towards climbing.

insight: Walk away from lane instead of TPing early in rotations. This preserves TP to return quickly if carry gets into trouble, improving your response time when carry makes mistakes.

insight: Stay in lane longer only if carry farms slowly (Ricky Carrie, Ursa, Chaos Knight) and you're getting consistent double kills. Most situations, rotating to apply pressure elsewhere outweighs potential kills in your lane.
